overrides.name: conversations
overrides.sql: CREATE TABLE "conversations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workspace_id" TEXT NULL, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES spaces (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "title" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "anchor_message_id" TEXT REFERENCES conversation_messages(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "created_by_principal_id" TEXT NULL, "leaf_message_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

overrides.name: conversation_messages
overrides.sql: CREATE TABLE "conversation_messages" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES spaces (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "conversation_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES conversations (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "sender_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sender_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_chars" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "message_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'text', "metadata" TEXT NULL, "list_metadata" TEXT NULL, "transcript_chars" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "parent_message_id" TEXT NULL, "compacted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("compacted" IN (0, 1)), "reverted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("reverted" IN (0, 1)), "reverted_at" INTEGER NULL, "embedding" BLOB NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "context_tokens" INTEGER NULL, "context_window_tokens" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

overrides.name: calendar_accounts
overrides.sql: CREATE TABLE "calendar_accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "provider_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'google', "account_email" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NULL, "last_synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "auth_expired_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

overrides.name: user_activity
overrides.sql: CREATE TABLE "user_activity" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_type" TEXT NULL, "target_id" TEXT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NULL, "ip" TEXT NULL, "country_code" TEXT NULL, "details" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

overrides.name: action_policies
overrides.sql: CREATE TABLE "action_policies" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "scope_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "scope_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "action_class" TEXT NULL, "command_prefix" TEXT NULL, "decision" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'prompt', "provenance" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user', "constraint_json" TEXT NULL, "expires_at" INTEGER NULL, "enforcement" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("workspace_id", "scope_type", "scope_id", "action_class", "command_prefix"))
